actual_result: Precondition setup: POST /api/user/ for a brand-new username returned 200, but a subsequent GET /api/user/validateUserName/<same username> still reported the username as available (true) — the account was never actually persisted. Attempt 1 login (userName=qa_postlogin_1791200085, password=Passw0rd1): 401. Retry with a second freshly-registered account (userName=qa_postlogin2_1791200149, gender=Male): registration again returned 200 but validateUserName again showed the username as still available; login again returned 401. Root cause appears to be the same server-side registration bug documented in TC-REGISTER-USERNAME-006 (POST /api/user/ returns 200 without actually creating the user record), which blocks this case's precondition from ever being satisfied.
